API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APITroubleshootingStart deep trace on a device
Start deep trace on a device
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/deeptraces

Start deep trace on a device. Limited to 1 active session on a device at any time. Overall 15 active sessions at any point of time across all devices (includes sessions initiated from UI).

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
session_name
string

Name of the deep tracing session

app_id
integer

Application ID

web_probe_id
integer

Web probe ID

cloudpath_probe_id
integer

Cloudpath probe ID

session_length_minutes
integer

Session length in minutes (upto 15 mins)

Default value: 300
probe_device
boolean

probe device for device level stats

Responses
​
200
401
403

Deep trace request accepted

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
trace_id
integer
status
string

Possible values: [not_started, in_progress, error, done]

expected_time
integer

expected time of completion in epoch seconds
